name: Anxious Oaf

shapes: continuous partyRestriction: { role:"any", minMembers: 2 } -- a forming attacking OR blocking party that includes this card must have >=2 members or the declareAttack/declareBlockers is rejected

notes: Brief names this card for `party-composition-restriction`. 'formed including this card' covers both roles -> role:"any". `berserker` is a subtype, not a keyword.

name: Assimilation Center

shapes: activated RECRUIT: costs [payResources 1, deplete source]; effects [chooserSelectsTarget chooser=controller, declaration {selector {owner self, zone deck, type character}, count 1, optional} -> [shuffleDeck(controller), moveCard {selected} to deck position top]]

notes: Deck search (emits deckSearched). Per CR §312.1 a searched deck is shuffled; the card's own 'put it on top' then places the found character on top of the shuffled deck -> explicit shuffleDeck before the moveCard-to-top (chooserSelectsTarget does not auto-shuffle). Search is failable (CR §312.2) -> optional. Reveal is cosmetic (no hidden-info model).

name: Barbaric Rifleman

shapes: triggered:cardEnteredPlay + sourceIsEventCard -> dealDamage({factionOf opponent}, 1)

notes: 'an opponent's faction' collapses to the one opponent in 2p. Faction damage -> influence loss (CR §408.3), and 'when damage inflicted' triggers still see it.

name: Battle Surge

shapes: tactic effect: forEach {selector {controller self, type character}} -> createModifier(__candidate, strength, add, 1, untilEndOfTurn)

notes: One-shot at resolution over characters you control at that instant -- not an aura, so characters deployed later this turn are unaffected. 'this turn' -> untilEndOfTurn.

name: Blow Up

shapes: tactic: targets [item: {type item} count 1]; effects [destroy {selected item}, modifyInfluence({controllerOf {selected item}}, -3)]

notes: 'an item' = any item (yours or an opponent's). Text order preserved; the destroyed item retains `controllerId` in the discard pile so `controllerOf` still resolves for the influence loss. Direct 'loses 3 influence' is not damage (CR §408.3b).

name: Callow Liegeman

shapes: triggered:characterAttacked + and(sourceIsEventCard, numberCompare(battlePartySize{side:"attacking"}, ">", 1)) -> [createModifier(source, strength, add, 1, untilEndOfTurn), createModifier(source, life, add, 1, untilEndOfTurn)]

notes: Brief names this card for `battle-party-size-expression` ('in a party with more than 1 member'). characterAttacked fires once per attacker at declareAttack with the full attacking party already formed; sourceIsEventCard scopes to this card.

name: Deadly Striker

shapes: triggered:cardDestroyed + sourceIsEventCard -> modifyInfluence(opponent, -4)

notes: Direct influence loss, not damage (CR §408.3b). 'an opponent's faction' -> the one opponent in 2p.

name: Dethmürderblüdgeon, the Craghammer

shapes: continuous: modifiers [{target attachedTo, strength +2}, {target attachedTo, life +2}]
triggered:attackerBlocked + eventCardIs("attachedTo") -> modifyInfluence(opponent, -2)

continuous grantedAbilities: [{selector {type character, conditions [isCard target:"attachedTo"]}, abilities [triggered:damageDealt + and(sourceIsDamageSource, cardTypeIs(eventCard,"faction")) -> targets [c: {type character} count 1 optional] -> if targetExists({selected c}) -> dealDamage({selected c}, 2)]}]
replacement: replaces {moveToZone, zone:discard} of source (condition sourceInZone play) -> moveCard(source -> hand)

notes: 'When the attached character inflicts damage to a faction' has no direct condition -- getEventCardId maps a damageDealt event to its TARGET, and sourceIsDamageSource is hard-wired to the ability's own source. Composed by granting the HOST a damageDealt trigger via grantedAbilities scoped with `selector-is-card` (isCard target:attachedTo); a granted trigger's source is the recipient (host), so sourceIsDamageSource then reads 'the host dealt it' (verified: findTriggers gives granted triggers context.sourceId = host). A dedicated `damageSourceIs(target)` condition (parallel to eventCardIs) would be cleaner and this clause recurs on ~4 other P2 gear cards -- flagged, not proposed since it composes. Discard-replacement catches both destruction and a direct 'put into discard'. 'you may pick a character' -> optional target + if targetExists. UNIQUE slug lowercased with diacritics kept.

name: Distraction

shapes: tactic: targets [c: {type character} count 1]; effects [deplete {selected c}]

notes: EXTRA COST pick + a single deplete effect. 'a character' = any character.

name: Elbow Dropper

shapes: activated OFF THE TOP ROPE: costs [deplete source]; targets [c: {type character} count 1]; effects [grantRestriction({selected c}, "cannotBlock", untilEndOfTurn)]

notes: 'This turn, the character cannot block' -> grantRestriction cannotBlock untilEndOfTurn.

name: Explosive Fury

shapes: tactic first-ability: targets [sac: {controller self, type character} count 1; victim: {type character} count 1]; effects [bind x = stat({selected sac}, strength), destroy {selected sac}, dealDamage({selected victim}, {variable x})]

notes: Brief-listed proven shape (bind X = strength BEFORE destroy, then reuse via {variable x}). 'another character' modelled as any character -- the sacrificed pick is destroyed before damage lands so re-picking it is a self-defeating no-op (CR §402.5). Add a `selector-is-card` exclusion in victim.conditions if strictness is wanted.

name: Fleshripping Scenepuller

shapes: triggered:attackerBlocked + sourceIsEventCard -> createModifier(source, strength, add, multiply[4, battlePartySize{side:"opposingParty", of:"source"}], untilEndOfTurn)

notes: Brief names this card for `battle-party-size-expression` ('for each member in the opposing party'). On an attackerBlocked event the opposing-party size = event.blockerCount. 'this turn' -> untilEndOfTurn.

name: Gore Engine

shapes: triggered:cardDestroyed + damagedThisTurn(target:eventCard, by:source) -> addCounter(source, "token", printedStat(eventCard, strength))
continuous self: modifiers [{target source, strength, add, counter(source, "token")}]
activated IMPALE: costs [oneOf([[payResources 2],[removeCounter source "token" 2]])]; targets [c: {type character} count 1]; effects [grantRestriction({selected c}, "mustBlock", untilEndOfTurn)]

notes: Brief: Gore Engine = `damaged-target-this-turn`. Token count uses printedStat -- the destroyed character is in the discard pile by trigger resolution so its live strength is not recoverable (concession). 'must block this card if it can' -> `mustBlock` restriction: forces the character into the blocking party against the attacking party that contains Gore Engine, and Gore Engine's controller then assigns its battle damage to it; does not literally pin the block to one attacker (concession). `oneOf` auto-pays the first affordable branch (payResources 2 preferred over dumping tokens) -- known engine limitation.

name: Infuriator

shapes: triggered:cardEnteredPlay + sourceIsEventCard -> forEach {selector {controller self, type character}} -> createModifier(__candidate, strength, add, 1, untilEndOfTurn)

notes: One-shot over characters you control at ETB resolution (not an aura); 'this turn' -> untilEndOfTurn.

name: Lieutenant General

shapes: triggered:characterAttacked + sourceIsEventCard -> forEach {selector {type character, subtype "soldier", conditions [sharesBattlePartyWithSource(__candidate), not(isCard(__candidate, target:"source"))]}} -> createModifier(__candidate, life, add, 1, untilEndOfTurn)

notes: 'all OTHER soldier characters in that party' -- sharesBattlePartyWithSource is true for source vs itself (verified impl), so `selector-is-card` (not isCard target:source) supplies the 'other' exclusion. Fires once (sourceIsEventCard) with the full attacking party already formed at declareAttack.

name: Morale Officer

shapes: activated CONVINCE: costs [deplete source]; effects [forEach {selector {controller self, type character, subtype "soldier"}} -> createModifier(__candidate, strength, add, 1, untilEndOfTurn)]

notes: One-shot over your soldier characters at resolution; 'this turn' -> untilEndOfTurn.

name: Murderous Commander

shapes: activated CUNNING PLAN: costs [payResources 2, discard {id:"d", player controller, selector {owner self, zone hand}, count 1}, deplete source]; effects [dealDamage({factionOf opponent}, 2)]

notes: Faction damage -> influence loss (CR §408.3). 'an opponent's faction' -> the one opponent in 2p.

name: Needless Beating

shapes: tactic: targets [c: {controller opponent, type character} count 1]; effects [dealDamage({selected c}, 2), if(statCompare({factionOf opponent}, influence, <=, 15)) -> dealDamage({selected c}, 1), if(statCompare({factionOf opponent}, influence, <=, 10)) -> forEach {selector {controller opponent, type character}} -> dealDamage(__candidate, 1), if(statCompare({factionOf opponent}, influence, <=, 5)) -> draw(controller, 1)]

notes: 'Pick an opponent' collapses to the one opponent in 2p (not a parity gap per brief). Each influence gate is checked at its point in resolution, after the prior damage->influence conversions, matching the card's sequencing.

name: Penetrate

shapes: tactic: targets [atk: {controller self, type character, conditions [inBattle(__candidate, role:"attacker")]} count 1]; effects [grantKeyword({selected atk}, "redirectDamage", untilEndOfTurn)]

notes: Brief: Penetrate = the already-implemented `redirectDamage` keyword granted to the picked attacker for the battle. Concession: `redirectDamage` appends the attack's original target as an EXTRA assignable option ('may ... instead'), whereas Penetrate reads mandatory -- the brief accepts the 'may ... instead' match.

name: Pinch

shapes: tactic: targets [c: {type character} count 1]; effects [dealDamage({selected c}, 1)]

notes: EXTRA COST pick + one dealDamage. 'a character' = any character.

name: Really Big Barduse

shapes: behavior.onPlay: targets [picks: {type character} count 2, optional]; effects [if targetExists({selected picks}) -> distributeAmong {chooser controller, selected "picks", amount 5, effects [dealDamage(__candidate, {variable __amount})]}]

notes: Non-tactic EXTRA COST (optional 0-2 picks) + ETB via behavior.onPlay. distributeAmong permits total < amount (verified: assert total <= amount), covering 'inflict up to 5 damage divided however you want'. 'if you picked characters' -> if targetExists gate (CR §402.5b).

name: Ruthless Platoon

shapes: activated CANNIBALIZE: targets [sac: {controller self, type character} count 1]; costs [destroy {selected sac}]; effects [createModifier(source, strength, add, 2, untilEndOfTurn)]

notes: 'Destroy a character you control' is a chosen non-numeric cost -> target declaration + destroy cost referencing it. 'This turn, this card gains 2 strength' -> untilEndOfTurn self modifier.

name: Sadistic Colonel

shapes: triggered:cardPlayed + and(eventPlayerIs opponent, cardTypeIs(eventCard, "tactic")) -> dealDamage({factionOf opponent}, 2)

notes: 'deploys a tactic' = cardPlayed of a tactic (tactics are always deployed, never merely 'put into play'; also fires on a tactic played as a response). Faction damage -> influence loss.

name: Skin Suit

shapes: tactic: targets [mine: {controller self, type character} count 1; theirs: {controller opponent, type character} count 1]; effects [bind x = stat({selected mine}, strength), bind y = stat({selected theirs}, strength), dealDamage({selected theirs}, {variable x}), dealDamage({selected mine}, {variable y})]
then (concession clause): if exactly one of {mine,theirs} would die from that damage -> removeFromGame(that one) + grantAbilitiesFrom({target: the survivor, from: the removed})

notes: `copy-rules-text` (grantAbilitiesFrom) covers 'the surviving character gains all rules text of the removed character'. Concessions (per brief's Skin Suit note): (a) 'simultaneously' -> two sequential dealDamage; the vocab has no simultaneous-damage-instance wrapper. (b) 'If only 1 of the characters would be destroyed by this damage, remove it from the game instead' -- there is no condition for 'would be destroyed by this damage' and no way to convert a single pending destruction into removeFromGame; left as a concession. If both or neither would die, the copy-text clause is skipped (CR §402.5b). Classified for the core.

name: Splattergun

shapes: activated UNLOAD: costs [deplete source]; targets [tgt: {conditions [or(cardTypeIs(__candidate,"character"), cardTypeIs(__candidate,"faction"))]} count 1]; effects [dealDamage({selected tgt}, 3), takeControl({target:"source", controller:{controllerOf {selected tgt}}})]

notes: 'Pick a character or faction' is an explicit faction pick (CR §202.9 satisfied). 'or' over cardTypeIs in selector.conditions since CardSelector.type is a single positive match. 'That faction's or character's controller takes control of this card' -> takeControl to {controllerOf tgt}, permanent (no 'this turn') -- the brief's recurring 'that player takes control of this card' pattern. Faction damage -> influence loss.

name: Suicide Squad

shapes: activated ULTIMATE SACRIFICE: variables {x: stat(source, strength)} (evaluated before costs); costs [destroy source]; targets [c: {type character} count 1]; effects [dealDamage({selected c}, {variable x})]

notes: ActivatedAbility.variables are evaluated before costs, so X captures this card's strength before the self-destroy cost.

name: Swordchucks

shapes: continuous: modifiers [{target attachedTo, strength +4}]
continuous: damageModifiers [{selector {conditions [isCard target:"attachedTo"]}, delta +2}]

activated HANDOFF: costs [payResources 3, deplete {selected wearer}]; targets [wearer: {controller self, type character, conditions [not(inBattle(__candidate))]} count 1]; effects [attachTo({target:"source", to:{selected wearer}})]

notes: Swordchucks is the brief's own `selector-is-card` example (a damageModifiers selector pinned to the attached character; delta +2 = 'increase the amount by 2'). HANDOFF is the brief's recurring re-attach pattern; 'not in a battle' via not(inBattle(__candidate)). Initial attach handled by the `attachTo:"character"` sibling.

name: Thundering Nilpha

shapes: continuous: condition and(inBattle(source, role:"attacker"), battleTargetIs(cardType:"location")); modifiers [{target source, strength +1}]; keywords [{target source, keyword "cannotBeBlocked"}]

notes: Brief names Thundering Nilpha for the `cannotBeBlocked` keyword, conditional via ContinuousAbility.keywords + condition. 'attacking a location' = source is an attacker AND the battle's target is a location (battleTargetIs cardType:location). Granted, not printed static -> metadata.keywords stays [].

name: Torrential Bleeder

shapes: triggered:turnStarted + eventPlayerIs(controller) -> forEach {selector {type character}} -> dealDamage(__candidate, 1)

notes: 'all characters' = every character in play, both players' (includes this card). 'At the start of your turn' -> turnStarted gated by eventPlayerIs(controller).

name: Trip Wire

shapes: tactic first-ability: condition battleRole:"defender"; targets [atk: {type character, conditions [inBattle(__candidate, role:"attacker")]} count = battlePartySize{side:"attacking"}]; effects [distributeAmong {chooser controller, selected "atk", amount 3, effects [dealDamage(__candidate, {variable __amount})]}]

notes: 'Deploy this only while you are being attacked' -> battleRole:"defender" gate (brief pattern). count = attacking-party size (brief names Trip Wire for this use of `battle-party-size-expression`) force-selects every attacking character into the declaration; distributeAmong then divides up to 3 among them (total < amount allowed -> 'up to 3').

name: Trophy Collector

shapes: behavior.onPlay.condition: statCompare({factionOf opponent}, influence, <=, 10) -- EXTRA COST deploy-legality gate, no effects

notes: Pure play-legality gate on a character; 'an opponent's faction' collapses to the one opponent in 2p. No ETB effects.

name: Wyrmfang Deathskull

shapes: triggered:characterAttacked + sourceIsEventCard -> restrictBlockersToChosen {chooser: opponent (controller of the attacked faction/location), declaration {selector {controller opponent, type character}, count up to count({controller opponent, type character}), optional}} -- only the chosen characters may block this battle and each must block if able

notes: Brief names Wyrmfang for `restrict-blockers-to-chosen` (bundle `block-eligibility-restriction`). 'When you attack' -> this card's own characterAttacked (fires at declareAttack, before blockers). Chooser = the defending player (the one opponent in 2p, controller of the faction/location being attacked). The effect covers both halves: 'only those characters can block' and 'must block ... if they can'.
